files.description: Four buildings x electricity/water/waste, 30 daily readings each, mild noise and weekend dip. No alerts expected.
Library runs about 2.3-2.6x normal for 3 consecutive days; Admin Block has a one-day spike; Hostel A is a normal control. 4 flagged readings.
Hostel B uses about 1.9x normal water for 6 consecutive days (timestamps carry +05:30). Science Block and Canteen are controls. 6 flagged readings.
Canteen waste is about 2.5x normal for 3 days; Hostel A has a one-day spike; Admin Block is a control. 4 flagged readings.
Three series with only 5, 6 and 3 readings (default minimum is 7 earlier readings), including a 3x spike that must NOT be judged. 0 flagged, all insufficient_data.
Auditorium water zero reading (suspect data), Gymnasium electricity drop to 30% (below baseline, no savings), Guest House sent as resource 'Electricity' / unit 'kwh' (normalized). 2 flagged readings.
All six scenarios above in one shuffled request; results must equal the separate runs and keep input order. 16 flagged readings.
Six records, five invalid (negative value, unknown resource, blank building, wrong unit, numeric epoch timestamp). Expect HTTP 422 with details for indices 1-5.
